Patch Set 5:

(11 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. This is presented as a pure code-motion/abstraction patch, but two behaviours change on the way through: the BPS rate clamp is dropped (divide-by-zero in nrs_rule_alloc()) and the `nodemap` classification type is deleted. Both are restored later in the relation chain, but each patch is expected to stand on its own, so the clamp at least should come back here.

commit.message:
LU-20099 nrs: abstract rule-based classful NRS scheduler

This patch abstracts the data structures related to the
rule-based classful scheduler and separates the general data
strctures from the TBF scheduler codes and make them
independent.
And then, it can be reused by the other rule-based classful
scheduling algorithms easily (such as mClock).
